cadence: Shorts: Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday at 20:43 Asia/Bangkok. Main episode: Sunday at 20:15 Asia/Bangkok.
production_buffer: Sunday Studio shift prepares Monday/Wednesday Shorts. Thursday Studio shift prepares Friday/Saturday Shorts and the Sunday main episode. Production completes before the release window; it never waits for the evening publisher.
pacing_policy: Shorts: exactly 5 seconds per scene, minimum 10 scenes and 50 seconds, maximum 180 seconds. Main episode: the format-specific Quality Gate applies.
rule: A planned item is never published until it has a complete script, fresh scene assets, matched narration, evidence where needed, and a passing Video QA report. Legacy drafts below the 50-second / 10-scene standard are audit-only and cannot fill a release slot.
